name: Seed Junky x 5 Bubble Hash Infused Prerolls | Chrome Kush
description:
Chrome Kush is the ultimate old school meets new school. This flower delivers a bold fusion of pungent gas and earthy kush with a unique metallic edge that gives the strain its name. Built for OG lovers, the inhale is loud and fuel-forward with rich kush undertones, while the exhale leaves behind a tangy sweetness. This indica provides deeply relaxing, euphoric effects that settle heavily into the body, making it ideal for unwinding, evening sessions and full body relaxation. 

Hollywood Pure Kush x Permanent Marker

Single sourced hash infused pre-rolls. New premium indoor flavors, double the hash! No shake, no trim, double the hash!
